_doc: DEFAULT real training config for Ranked-SFT / RL (rlvr.autoresearch.run_experiment) on a v1 dataset. Multi-epoch (8 epochs, 16 generations) over the FULL pointed dataset (no n_train_cap/n_val_cap => uses every scene). The keys below are the run_experiment config (passed verbatim via --config); sft_batch_size / train_epochs (and n_train_cap / n_val_cap when explicitly set, e.g. in rsft_ci.json) are consumed by the verify script (stripped from --config, passed as CLI flags / used to subsample). For a quick PR check on a small random subsample use rsft_ci.json instead.
